title: The repository now leads with Guesswork, and Design Thinking becomes its companion skill
why: Vibe coders search for review and memory tools, not design thinking; the existing skill keeps its full content
alternatives: Keep Design Thinking as the headline and add Guesswork as a feature
Move Guesswork to its own new repository

resolution.decision: The repository now leads with Guesswork, and Design Thinking becomes its companion skill
resolution.note: Owner delegated this call ("you decide what is best"). One repository keeps the history, stars, and contributors the open source program counts. Renaming the repository to guesswork is recommended; GitHub redirects old links.
